title: Portable Temperature Probe Verification Cycle
summary: Routine comparison of two portable temperature probes against an in-date reference at three operating points; both units remained within the stated tolerance.

sections.title: RECORD IDENTIFICATION
sections.body:
**Project / Study Title:** Portable Temperature Probe Verification Cycle

**Department / Unit:** Industrial Instrumentation

**Principal Researcher:** Instrumentation Technician (role)

**Supporting Personnel:** Quality Reviewer (role)

**Facility / Room:** General calibration workspace

**Date Opened:** 2026-08-17

**Target Completion:** 2026-08-18

**Related Work Order / File No.:** INS-WO-2608-014

sections.title: PURPOSE & SCOPE
sections.body:
**Research Question / Objective:** Verify that two portable temperature probes remain within ±0.5 °C of the reference at 0 °C, 25 °C, and 50 °C.

**Expected Practical Use:** Confirm suitability for routine laboratory checks and pre-deployment field measurements.

**Prior Work Referenced:** Current calibration register and manufacturer operating instructions.

**Normal Operating Assumptions:** Instruments are undamaged, batteries are serviceable, and readings are taken only after stabilization.

sections.title: MATERIALS & EQUIPMENT
sections.body:
**Equipment / Asset IDs:** TP-014; TP-019; reference thermometer REF-006; dry-block unit DB-002.

**Samples / Materials:** No research samples; distilled-water ice-point media only.

**Calibration / Control Standard:** REF-006 certificate confirmed in date before use.

**Required PPE / Safety Controls:** Laboratory coat, eye protection, and heat-resistant gloves for handling above 40 °C.

sections.title: PROCEDURE & RESULTS
sections.body:
**Procedure / Method No.:** Three-point comparison; three stabilized readings per probe at each set point.

**Control / Baseline:** Reference thermometer REF-006.

**Measurement Interval:** 60 seconds between stabilized readings.

**Deviation From Method:** None.

**Result Summary:** TP-014 maximum absolute deviation was 0.2 °C. TP-019 maximum absolute deviation was 0.3 °C. Both units met the ±0.5 °C acceptance tolerance.

**Disposition:** Archive

**Observations / Technician Notes:** Display response, cable condition, and battery checks were normal. Calibration labels were renewed through the next scheduled verification interval.

**Researcher / Reviewer Signatures & Dates:** Instrumentation Technician — 2026-08-18; Quality Reviewer — 2026-08-18 (role-only publication copy).
